blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Omnidirectional videos (ODVs) capture dynamic environments with a full $360^\circ$ field of view, providing rich spatial context and temporal dynamics for applications such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and embodied intelligence. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made great progress in spatial and temporal understanding, yet their ability to comprehend the immersive 360 spatio-temporal information conveyed by ODVs remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we first introduce OmniV-Bench, a Benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the capabilities of MLLMs on spatio-temporal Omnidirectional Video understanding. OmniV-Bench contains 4,123 high-quality ODVs collected from diverse scenes, along with 8,923 human-annotated question-answer pairs spanning 11 fine-grained tasks across three categories, i.e., general, spatial, and spatio-temporal understanding. Extensive benchmark experiments reveal that the spatio-temporal complexity of ODVs poses significant challenges for current MLLMs. To address these limitations, we further propose OmniV-Harness, an agentic harness that enhances ODV understanding through viewpoint-guided evidence initialization and task-relevant evidence acquisition with adaptive tool use. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that OmniV-Harness consistently improves immersive spatio-temporal reasoning ability of MLLMs. Both OmniV-Bench and OmniV-Harness will be released upon publication.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Omnidirectional videos (ODVs) capture dynamic environments across a full spherical 360 ∘ field of view (FoV). Compared with conventional 2D videos or multi-view images, ODVs enable smooth immersive observation of the surrounding scene over time. Thus, ODVs are widely used in virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), spatial navigation, and hold great potential for embodied perception and scene understanding [ 33 , 41 ] .
blocks.zh: 央视视频(ODV)通过全球形360QQ视场(FoV)捕捉动态环境. 与常规的2D视频或多视图图像相比,ODV可以随着时间的推移对周围的场景进行平滑的浸润观察. 因此,ODV在虚拟现实(VR),增强现实(AR),空间导航中被广泛使用,具有体现感知和场景理解的巨大潜力[33,41].

blocks.en:
Although recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have led to significant progress in spatial and temporal understanding of conventional videos and multi-view images [ 31 , 36 , 13 ] , research on omnidirectional media understanding has predominantly focused on static images [ 32 , 7 , 42 ] , leaving omnidirectional video understanding largely underexplored. Existing ODV understanding benchmarks [ 27 , 37 ] are limited in either task scope or evaluation objective, as summarized in Table 1 , leaving comprehensive and multidimensional ODV
understanding insufficiently evaluated. Compared with static omnidirectional images, ODVs introduce rich temporal dynamics, while offering
more comprehensive spatial context within
180 ∘ × {}^{\circ}\times 360 ∘ immersive environments
than conventional videos. ODV understanding therefore requires jointly perceiving spatial relationships in omnidirectional environments and reasoning about how these relationships evolve over time.
These unique spatio-temporal characteristics pose additional challenges beyond both omnidirectional image understanding and conventional video understanding, highlighting the need for systematically evaluating MLLMs under ODV settings.

虽然最近在多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)上的进步,在对传统视频和多视图图像的空间和时间理解方面取得了重大进展[31,36,13],但关于全方位媒体理解的研究主要侧重于静态图像[32,7,42],但全方位视频理解在很大程度上未得到充分探讨. 如表1所概述,现有的ODV理解基准[27、37]在任务范围或评价目标方面都受到限制,因此留下了全面和多层面ODV
理解不足。 与静态全向图像相比,ODV引入了丰富的时间动态,同时提供
更全面的空间背景
180个时间 360 QQ 浸润环境
而不是传统的视频。 因此,ODV理解需要在全方位环境中共同了解空间关系,并推理这些关系如何随时间演变。
这些独特的时空特征带来了额外的挑战,超出了对全方位图像的理解和常规视频的理解,突出了在ODV设置下系统评价MLLM的必要性.

blocks.en:
To address this gap, we first introduce OmniV-Bench , a novel Bench mark designed to comprehensively evaluate the Omni directional V ideo understanding capabilities of MLLMs, as shown in Figure 1 (a). OmniV-Bench comprises 4,123 high-quality ODVs covering diverse indoor and outdoor scenes, together with 8,923 human-annotated QA pairs spanning 11 fine-grained tasks across three complementary dimensions, including general understanding, spatial reasoning, and spatio-temporal reasoning. This benchmark enables a systematic evaluation of immersive ODV understanding.
Based on OmniV-Bench, we conduct extensive evaluation among various general-purpose and spatial-centric MLLMs. Benchmark results reveal that current MLLMs face substantial challenges in understanding immersive omnidirectional environments, particularly in spatial and spatio-temporal reasoning tasks.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一差距,我们首先引入了OmniV-Bench,这是一款小说班座标记,旨在全面评价MLLMs的Omni方向V思想理解能力,如图1(a)所示。 OmniV-Bench包括4 123个高质量的 ODV覆盖不同室内和室外场景,加上8,923对人类附加说明的QA对,跨越了包括一般理解,空间推理和时空推理在内的三个互补维度的11个精细任务. 这一基准能够对浸润性ODV的理解进行系统评价。
基于OmniV-Bench,我们对各种通用和以空间为中心的MLLMs进行了广泛的评价。 基准结果显示,目前的MLLMs在理解浸润性全向环境,特别是在空间和时空推理任务方面面临重大挑战。

blocks.en:
To further improve 360 ∘ spatio-temporal reasoning ability of MLLMs, we introduce OmniV-Harness , the first agentic harness tailored for omnidirectional video understanding.
OmniV-Harness first employs viewpoint-guided evidence initialization to provide direction-aware guidance for subsequent spatio-temporal reasoning.
It then performs adaptive evidence acquisition, enabling MLLMs
to actively acquire additional evidence through agentic visual tool use. This design allows models to selectively explore task-relevant timestamps, viewing directions, and spatial regions, acquiring task-relevant spatio-temporal evidence to refine their predictions before producing the final response.
Experiments on OmniV-Bench demonstrate that OmniV-Harness consistently improves both proprietary and open-source MLLMs across different model scales. The main highlights of this work include: • We propose OmniV-Bench , a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on omnidirectional video understanding, comprising 4,123 high-quality ODVs and 8,923 human-annotated QA pairs across 11 fine-grained general, spatial and spatio-temporal tasks. • We conduct extensive evaluations of general-purpose and spatial-centric MLLMs on ODV comprehension tasks, revealing their substantial limitations to comprehend immersive
spatio-temporal environments. • We propose OmniV-Harness , an agentic harness that performs viewpoint-guided
evidence initialization and task-relevant evidence acquisition with adaptive visual tool use. • Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of OmniV-Harness on both proprietary and open-source models.

blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 General Spatial Understanding Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.1 一般空间理解基准

blocks.en:
With the rapid advancement of MLLMs, multimodal evaluation has expanded from general-level understanding [ 12 , 16 , 24 ] toward spatial-level understanding [ 11 , 31 , 15 ] . Existing spatial understanding benchmarks typically evaluate MLLMs using perspective images, multi-view images, or normal-field-of-view (NFOV) videos, as summarized in Table 1 . However, such visual inputs typically capture only
partial observations of the surrounding environment. In contrast, omnidirectional images provide complete scene coverage within a single frame, while omnidirectional videos further extend such immersive observations over time.
The combination of holistic spatial context and temporal dynamics makes ODV understanding and its evaluation particularly valuable for a wide range of applications, including immersive VR/AR, spatial navigation, autonomous perception, embodied intelligence, and dynamic scene analysis.
blocks.zh:
随着微额供资和微型企业的迅速发展,多式联运评价已从一般层面的理解[12、16、24]扩大到空间层面的理解[11、31、15]。 现有的空间理解基准一般使用视角图像、多视图图像或正常视野视频来评价MLLMs,见表1。 然而,这种视觉输入通常只捕捉到
对周围环境的部分观测。 相比之下,全方位图像在单个框架内提供完整的场景覆盖,而全方位视频则随着时间的推移进一步延伸这种浸润观测.
综合空间背景和时间动态的结合,使ODV理解及其评价对包括浸润VR/AR、空间导航、自主感知、内含智能和动态场景分析在内的广泛应用特别有价值。

blocks.en: 2.2 Omnidirectional Image and Video Understanding Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 直观图像和视频理解基准

blocks.en:
Several benchmarks have been proposed for omnidirectional image and video understanding,
as summarized in Table 1 .
Existing studies predominantly focus on
ODI understanding. Dense360-Bench [ 42 ] evaluates captioning and grounding, while ODI-Bench [ 32 ] covers both general and spatial understanding across diverse scenes.
However, research on ODV understanding remains limited, with existing benchmarks focusing on specific tasks and scenarios.
Pano-AVQA [ 37 ] targets spherical spatial and audio-visual reasoning, whereas 360CityArena [ 27 ] focuses on embodied urban navigation in outdoor urban environments. As a result, comprehensive ODV understanding,
particularly the joint reasoning over immersive
spatial context and temporal dynamics, remains
insufficiently evaluated. Our OmniV-Bench addresses this gap by providing a comprehensive evaluation of general, spatial, and spatio-temporal understanding across diverse ODV scenes.

blocks.en: 3 OmniV-Bench
blocks.zh: 3 OmniV 奔驰

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: We introduce OmniV-Bench, a benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate MLLMs on omnidirectional video understanding. OmniV-Bench comprises 4,123 high-quality indoor and outdoor ODVs, together with 8,923 human-annotated question-answer pairs across 11 fine-grained general, spatial and spatio-temporal tasks, enabling a systematic evaluation of MLLMs in complex, immersive, and dynamically evolving environments.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了OmniV-Bench,这个基准旨在全面评价MLLMs的全向视频理解. OmniV-Bench包含4,123个高质量的室内和室外ODV,以及8,923个人类附加说明的问答对联,涉及11个精细的一般任务、空间任务和时空任务,能够在复杂、浸润和动态变化的环境中对MLLM进行系统评价。

blocks.en: 3.2 Fine-grained Task Definition
blocks.zh: 3.2 精细任务定义

blocks.en:
Existing ODV benchmarks primarily focus on specialized
settings, such as audio-visual question answering or embodied navigation [ 27 , 37 ] , leaving the unique spatial and spatio-temporal characteristics of ODVs insufficiently explored. In contrast, OmniV-Bench aims to systematically assess the general-purpose ODV comprehension capabilities of MLLMs across three complementary dimensions, i.e. , general, spatial and spatio-temporal, with the task distribution shown in Figure 2 (b).
blocks.zh:
现有的防止家庭暴力基准主要侧重于:
设置,例如视听问题回答或包含的导航[27,37],使ODV的独特空间和时空特征没有得到充分的探讨。 相比之下,OmniV-Bench旨在系统地评估MLLMs在三个互补维度,即一般、空间和时空的普通用途ODV理解能力,任务分布见图2(b)。

blocks.en: We introduce four general-level ODV understanding tasks, i.e. , attribute recognition, counting, existence, and ODV reasoning , to evaluate the basic comprehension capabilities of MLLMs. These tasks do not explicitly require complex spatial or spatio-temporal reasoning. Instead, their primary challenge lies in perceiving dense visual information distributed across omnidirectional scenes. Attribute recognition evaluates fine-grained perception by requiring models to localize task-relevant objects in complex scenes and identify their properties, such as color, material, and appearance. Counting and existence assess global perception by requiring models to comprehensively inspect the omnidirectional scene to determine object quantities or verify the presence of specific objects. ODV reasoning further evaluates the ability to integrate visual evidence with semantic and real-world knowledge to infer plausible scene-level conclusions.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了四项一般层面的ODV理解任务,即属性识别,计数,存在,ODV推理,以评估MLLM的基本理解能力. 这些任务没有明确要求复杂的空间或时空推理. 相反,它们面临的主要挑战在于能够看到分布在全景区的密集视觉信息。 属性识别通过要求模型在复杂场景中定位与任务相关的对象并识别其属性,如颜色,材料,以及外观,来评价精细的纹理感知. 盘点和存在通过要求模型全面检查全向场景来评估全局认知,以确定物体数量或验证特定物体的存在. ODV推理进一步评价了将视觉证据与语义和现实世界知识相结合的能力,从而推断出可信的场景级结论.

blocks.en:
This dimension composes of two spatial-level tasks, i.e. , egocentric viewpoint understanding and allocentric viewpoint understanding , These tasks do not necessarily require temporal reasoning but emphasize spatial localization and
viewpoint-dependent reasoning. Egocentric viewpoint understanding evaluates spatial relations with respect to the VR viewer or ego camera, while allocentric viewpoint understanding requires models to reason from the perspective of
another entity in the scene.
blocks.zh:
这个维度由两个空间层面的任务组成,即自我中心观点的理解和对异心观点的理解, 这些任务不一定需要时间推理,而是强调空间本地化和
观点依赖推理. egocentral观点 理解评价与VR查看器或自负相机的空间关系,而 Alsocentral观点 理解则需要模型从以下角度进行推理:
现场的另一个实体。

blocks.en: Beyond general perception and spatial reasoning, understanding ODVs requires models to integrate visual evidence distributed across the surrounding scenes and evolving over time. Therefore, we introduce five spatio-temporal tasks, i.e. , motion perception, event ordering, state tracking, temporal span, and timestamp localization , to evaluate MLLMs’ ability to jointly reason about spatial and temporal information. Motion perception and state tracking assess the ability to recognize motion and track changes in object states over time. Event ordering and temporal span evaluate the ability to reconstruct event sequences and estimate their temporal extent. Timestamp localization further requires models to associate observations across different viewing directions with specific moments or intervals in the video.
blocks.zh: 除了一般感知和空间推理外,理解ODV还需要模型整合分布在周围场景的视觉证据,并随时间演变. 因此,我们引入了五个时空任务,即运动感知、事件顺序、状态跟踪、时间跨度和时间戳本地化,以评估MLLMs在空间和时间信息方面的联合理性能力。 运动感知和状态跟踪评估识别运动和跟踪物体状态随时间变化的能力. 事件顺序和时间跨度评价重建事件序列的能力并估计其时间范围. 时间戳本地化进一步要求模型将不同取景方向的观测与视频中的特定时刻或间隔联系起来.

blocks.zh: 3.3 基准建设

blocks.en: The benchmark construction procedure is as illustrated in Figure 3 . Videos in our benchmark are collected from diverse open sources, including web-crawled content and public datasets [ 21 , 23 , 3 , 10 , 22 ] and are carefully selected to ensure both quality and diversity. As presented in Figure 2 (a), the collected videos cover a wide range of real-world indoor and outdoor environments, including urban streets, public spaces, natural scenes, and indoor activities, thereby providing diverse visual contexts for omnidirectional understanding. To ensure data quality, all videos undergo a data-cleaning pipeline that removes static or content-poor scenes, near-duplicate samples, and videos with noticeable quality degradation, such as severe blurring, extreme exposure, or temporal discontinuities. Long videos are further segmented into shorter clips to retain informative and temporally coherent content while avoiding redundancy.
blocks.zh: 基准建造程序如图3所示。 我们基准中的视频是从各种公开来源收集的,包括网络浏览内容和公共数据集[21、23、3、10、22],并且经过仔细挑选,以确保质量和多样性。 如图2(a)所示,所收集的视频涵盖广泛的现实世界室内和室外环境,包括城市街道、公共场所、自然场景和室内活动,从而提供了全方位理解的各种视觉环境。 为确保数据质量,所有视频都要经过一个数据清理管道,清除静态或内容贫乏的场景、接近复制的样本以及质量明显退化的视频,如严重模糊、极端暴露或时间不连续。 长视频被进一步分解为较短的片段,以保留信息性和时间一致性的内容,同时避免冗余.

blocks.en:
Unlike conventional images, where viewers observe a scene from an external perspective, omnidirectional media place the viewer at the center of the visual environment and support immersive exploration across different viewing directions. To better reflect this viewing paradigm, we formulate questions using first-person and viewer-centric expressions, making the annotations more consistent with how omnidirectional videos are naturally experienced and interacted with. This design also better aligns with practical ODV applications such as embodied perception, spatial navigation, and immersive interaction, etc. All QA pairs in OmniV-Bench, including questions,
answers, and answer choices, are manually annotated
to preserve natural and diverse question formulations. The annotation process involves 30 annotators over one month. Before annotation, all annotators receive dedicated training on the task definitions, annotation criteria, and viewer-centric questioning principles. The annotators then watch the ODVs using VR devices and manually formulate questions and corresponding answers based on the video content. This immersive annotation process allows annotators
to examine the surrounding scenes from different
viewing directions and formulate questions based
on their observations. The resulting QA pairs cover multiple formats, including single-answer multiple-choice, multiple-answer multiple-choice, and yes/no questions.
To ensure annotation quality, all QA pairs undergo multiple rounds of automatic and manual verification. Samples with ambiguous answer choices, unclear question formulations, inconsistent question-answer pairs, or insufficient visual evidence are revised or removed.

blocks.en: In this section, we conduct extensive benchmark experiment on the proposed OmniV-Bench and provide an in-depth analysis of the experimental results.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们对提议的OmniV-Bench进行了广泛的基准试验,并对实验结果进行了深入分析。

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate 30 leading MLLMs with diverse architectures and model scales on OmniV-Bench. The models can be categorized into three groups: (1) proprietary

For a fair comparison, we uniformly sample 50 frames from each ODV and evaluate all models using the same prompt template provided in the Appendix.
Model performance is measured by accuracy on
multiple-choice and yes/no questions.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Benchmark performances of all models across all tasks are reported in Table 2 . We additionally include Blind Gemini-2.5-flash, i.e., Gemini-2.5-flash without visual inputs and chance-level accuracy as baselines for reference. Based on these results, several key findings are identified to highlight the limitations of current MLLMs in ODV understanding and provide insights
for future research.
blocks.zh:
所有任务的所有模型的基准业绩见表2。 我们还包括盲双子座2.5-闪电,即没有视觉输入的双子座2.5-闪电和机会级精确度作为基准参考. 根据这些结果,确定了几项关键结论,以突出当前防止家庭暴力运动理解的 MLLM 的局限性,并提供见解
未来研究。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Overall Performance

As shown in Table 2 , proprietary MLLMs generally achieve the strongest overall performance, with Seed-2.0-pro ranking first at 60.25%. Open-source MLLMs also demonstrate competitive performance, with Qwen3.5.27B achieving 59.18%, approaching leading proprietary models. However, even the best-performing models are still far from satisfactory. These results suggest that:
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,专有的MLLMs总体表现最强,种子-2.0-pro排名第一,为60.25%. 开源MLLMs也表现出竞争性能,Quen3.5.27B实现59.18%,接近领先的专有模式. 然而,即使是表现最好的模式也远远不能令人满意。 这些结果表明:

blocks.en: ODV understanding remains challenging for MLLMs across different model scales.
blocks.zh: 对不同模型尺度的MLLMs的ODV理解仍然具有挑战性.

blocks.en:
Moreover, spatial-centric MLLMs generally underperform leading general-purpose MLLMs on OmniV-Bench. For instance, the best-performing spatial-centric model, VST-3B-SFT, achieves an overall accuracy of 48.96%, falling behind several general-purpose MLLMs. Despite their explicit focus on spatial understanding, these models do not exhibit a consistent advantage in ODV comprehension.
This observation suggests that:
blocks.zh:
此外,以空间为中心的MLLMs在OmniV-Bench上的通用MLLMs通常表现不佳。 例如,性能最好的空间中心模型VST-3B-SFT总的精度达到48.96%,落后于几个通用的MLLMs. 尽管这些模型明确侧重于空间理解,但在ODV理解方面并没有表现出一贯的优势.
这一意见表明:

blocks.en: ODV understanding presents unique challenges that remain insufficiently addressed by existing spatial reasoning capabilities.
blocks.zh: 对ODV的理解提出了独特的挑战,而现有的空间推理能力仍不足以应对这些挑战。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Task-wise Performance
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 任务性能

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , model performance varies considerably across different task categories. For general-level tasks, the dense visual information in immersive scenes poses challenges to basic visual perception, particularly in counting tasks, where models struggle to accurately identify and aggregate objects across the surrounding environment. Performance generally declines on spatial tasks, revealing the limitations of current MLLMs in reasoning about spatial relationships within omnidirectional environments. In particular, allocentric viewpoint understanding requires models to reason from a specified viewpoint, demanding both accurate spatial localization and viewpoint-dependent reasoning across the immersive environment. Compared with egocentric viewpoint understanding, allocentric reasoning exhibits substantially lower accuracy across the evaluated models.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,不同任务类别的模型性能差异很大。 对于一般层面的任务,浸润场景中密集的视觉信息对基本视觉感知提出了挑战,特别是在计数任务中,模型在周围环境中努力准确识别和聚合物体. 空间任务的性能普遍下降,揭示了当前MLLM在全向环境中空间关系的推理上的局限性. 特别是,对异心观点的理解要求模型从特定角度进行推理,要求精确的空间定位和在浸润环境中依赖观点的推理。 与以自我为中心的观点理解相比,全方位推理在被评价模型中显示的准确性要低得多。

blocks.en:
Spatio-temporal tasks introduce even further challenges. While immersive perception of omnidirectional environments already imposes substantial demands on spatial reasoning, incorporating temporal dynamics further challenges the understanding of evolving scenes. Models exhibit particularly poor performance on event ordering, temporal span estimation, and timestamp localization, which require tracking dynamic events and reasoning about their temporal relationships across complex spatial contexts. Performance on several of these tasks remains close to chance level, with only marginal improvements over the blind Gemini baseline in some cases,
revealing substantial limitations in perceiving and reasoning about dynamic events within immersive environments.
Moreover, the considerable performance variation
across models highlights disparities in their
spatio-temporal understanding capabilities.
These observations suggest that:
blocks.zh:
时空任务带来更多挑战。 虽然对全方位环境的浸润感已经对空间推理提出了很大要求,但纳入时间动态进一步挑战了对不断变化的场景的理解。 模型在事件顺序、时间跨度估计和时间戳本地化方面表现特别差,这需要跟踪动态事件,并推理其跨复杂空间背景的时间关系。 其中几项任务的业绩仍然接近于机会水平,在某些情况下,仅比盲目的双子座基线略有改善,
揭示了对浸润环境中动态事件的感知和推理的巨大局限性.
此外,业绩差异很大
各种模式突出显示其差异
时空理解能力.
这些意见表明:

blocks.en:
Spatial complexity, particularly when coupled
with temporal dynamics, constitutes a major
bottleneck for ODV understanding.
blocks.zh:
空间复杂性,特别是结合
具有时间动态,构成一个主要的
理解ODV的瓶颈。

blocks.en: 5 OmniV-Harness
blocks.zh: 5 OmniV - 和谐

blocks.en: In this section, we present OmniV-Harness , an agent harness that enhances MLLMs’ comprehension abilities on immersive omnidirectional videos.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍OmniV-Harness,

blocks.en: 5.1 Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 5.1 框架概览

blocks.en:
Compared with conventional video understanding, omnidirectional videos introduce additional
challenges, as task-relevant evidence may be distributed
across different viewing directions and timestamps,
while substantial visual redundancy in immersive
spatio-temporal scenes makes it difficult to identify
informative observations.
blocks.zh:
与传统视频理解相比,全方位视频引入了更多
挑战,因为可能分发与任务相关的证据
跨越不同的视线和时间戳,
在浸泡中大量视觉冗余
时空场景很难识别
资料性观察。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, OmniV-Harness performs viewpoint-guided evidence initialization to establish directional context and adaptive evidence aquisition to select task-relevant evidence, as presented in Figure 4 . The framework first establishes directional context from omnidirectional observations to facilitate subsequent spatial reasoning. Guided by the input query and accumulated evidence, MLLMs then adaptively explore relevant temporal timestamps, viewing directions, and cropped regions through iterative tool use. Finally, the framework integrates the acquired evidence to generate predictions, with further visual inspection when the available evidence is insufficient or conflict. Throughout this process, a sample-wise memory maintains the collected observations and intermediate reasoning states to support iterative evidence acquisition and answer refinement.
blocks.zh: 为应对这些挑战,OmniV-Harness进行了观点指导证据初始化,以确定方向背景和适应性证据请求,以选择与任务相关的证据,如图4所示。 框架首先从全向观测中确定方向背景,以便于随后的空间推理. 在输入查询和累积证据的指导下,MLLMs随后通过迭代工具的使用,适应性地探索了相关的时间时戳,查看方向和裁剪区域. 最后,框架综合了获得的证据,以产生预测,并在现有证据不足或冲突时进行进一步的视觉检查。 在整个过程中,一个抽样的内存保持了收集的观测和中间推理状态,以支持迭代证据的获取和答案的完善.

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Viewpoint-Guided Evidence Initialization
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 视点指导证据初始化

blocks.en:
Directly interpreting the equirectangular representation of ODVs makes the immersive
directional information difficult to identify. Therefore,
we adopt viewpoint-guided mechanism for evidence initialization. Specifically, the first
ODV frame is projected into six perspective views (front,
back, left, right, up, and down), each with a 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} field of view. In a single MLLM call,
the model generates a brief description of each view,
predicts the task type, and identifies observation
requirements, including candidate sampling timestamps.
These model-suggested timestamps are combined with
timestamps uniformly sampled at a low sampling rate
and temporal references from the query to construct
the initial observations. The resulting visual evidence
and directional context are maintained in the
sample-wise memory to guide subsequent evidence
acquisition.

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Adaptive Evidence Acquisition
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 适应性证据的获取

blocks.en:
Given the initialized visual evidence and directional
context, OmniV-Harness enables the MLLM to determine
whether and where additional visual evidences are needed.
Rather than relying on a fixed set of densely sampled
video frames, the model selectively explores the
video according to the input query and current evidence.
blocks.zh:
鉴于初步的视觉证据和方向性
上下文,OmniV-Harness使 MLLM 能够确定
是否和何处需要额外的视觉证据。
而不是依靠一套固定的密集样本
视频框,模型有选择地探索
根据输入查询和当前证据的视频。

blocks.en:
To support adaptive visual exploration, we provide
three complementary perception tools.
(1) Temporal sampling allows the model to inspect
additional timestamps to capture missing events or
refine temporal boundaries.
(2) Viewpoint rotation enables the model to
explore different viewing directions and fields of
view, facilitating spatial reasoning in immersive
environments.
(3) Region cropping further supports fine-grained
inspection of task-relevant objects and local regions.
Together, these tools enable selective evidence
acquisition across the spatial and temporal dimensions
of ODVs.
At each iteration, the MLLM issues structured tool
requests, which are validated and executed within
predefined budgets. The acquired observations,
together with their timestamps and directional context,
are incorporated into the sample-wise memory.
The updated evidence then guides subsequent tool use,
allowing the model to progressively focus on informative
spatio-temporal observations rather than following
a fixed sequence of visual operations.

时空观测而不是跟踪
固定的视觉操作序列。

blocks.en: 5.1.3 Evidence-Grounded Answer Generation
blocks.zh: 5.1.3 收集证据的答案

blocks.en:
Based on the acquired visual evidence, OmniV-Harness
enables the MLLM to generate a candidate answer by
integrating the observations and intermediate reasoning
states maintained in the sample-wise memory.
The model then assesses whether the available evidence
sufficiently supports its prediction, with task-specific
consistency checks applied when necessary to resolve
ambiguities in spatial relationships and temporal events.

根据获得的视觉证据 OmniV-Harness
使 MLLM 生成一个候选答案 :
综合各种意见和中间推理
在样本内存中保持状态。
该模型然后评估现有证据是否
足够支持其预测,具体任务

空间关系和时间事件不明确。

When additional evidence is needed, the model returns
to the adaptive evidence acquisition stage to gather
further observations and refine its prediction based
on the updated evidence.
This iterative review-and-refinement process continues
until the model determines that sufficient evidence
is available or the predefined interaction budget
is reached.

blocks.en: 6.2 Performance Comparison with Other Harnesses
blocks.zh: 6.2 与其他方法的性能比较

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Comparison between Codex, Deepseek-Harness and OmniV-Harness (ours) on OmniV-Bench.
blocks.zh: 图5:OmniV-Bench上的Codex,Deepseek-Harness和OmniV-Harness(我们)之间的比较.

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of different harness frameworks for ODV understanding, we randomly sample 100 questions from each task for comparison. For a fair comparison, all harnesses employ Qwen3.7-Plus as the execution model with identical model configurations. Notably, we impose no additional restrictions on the permissions or tool usage of DeepSeek Harness or Codex Harness, allowing them to operate with their full native capabilities.
blocks.zh: 为了全面评估不同驾驭框架的实效和效率,我们随机抽取每项任务的100个问题进行比较。 为了进行公平的比较,所有的牵引装置都采用Quen3.7-Plus作为具有相同模型配置的处决模型. 值得注意的是,我们对DeepSeek Harness或Codex Harness的许可或工具使用没有额外的限制,允许它们以完全本土能力运作.

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 5 , OmniV-Harness achieves
the highest overall accuracy on OmniV-Bench, outperforming both DeepSeek Harness and Codex Harness. Moreover, OmniV-Harness requires only 4.37 execution rounds and 53.22 seconds per question on average, representing reductions of 72.9% in execution rounds and 52.2% in inference time compared with DeepSeek Harness. These results demonstrate that OmniV-Harness achieves superior performance with substantially lower execution overhead, highlighting the advantages of our ODV-oriented harness design for immersive spatio-temporal understanding.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we first introduce OmniV-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating MLLMs’ understanding capabilities of immersive omnidirectional videos. OmniV-Bench comprises 4,123 high-quality ODVs along with 8,923 human-annotated question-answer pairs spanning 11 fine-grained tasks across general, spatial, and spatio-temporal categories. 30 leading MLLMs are comprehensively evaluated, revealing substantial limitations in their ability to comprehend immersive spatio-temporal environments. To address these limitations, we further propose OmniV-Harness, an agent harness that enhances MLLMs’ ODV understanding through viewpoint-guided evidence initialization and adaptive evidence aquisition. Together, OmniV-Bench and OmniV-Harness highlight the challenges of immersive spatio-temporal understanding and offer a promising direction for advancing MLLMs’ capabilities in omnidirectional environments.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们首先引入了OmniV-Bench,这是评价MLLMs对浸泡性全向视频的理解能力的全面基准. OmniV-Bench包括4 123个高质量的ODV,以及8 923个人类附加说明的问答对,涉及11个精细任务,涉及一般、空间和时空类别。 30种主要的MLLM得到全面评估,揭示了它们理解浸泡性时空环境的能力的重大局限性。 为了克服这些局限性,我们进一步提议OmniV-Harness,一种通过观点指导证据初始化和适应性证据求同存异,增强MLLMs ODV理解的代理工具。 OmniV-Bench和OmniV-Harness一起强调浸泡性时空理解的挑战,并为在全方位环境中提高MLLMs的能力提供有希望的方向。
